teaser: RC2 is printed: two A4 review copies from Prontaprint Chiswick, two newsroom pages in the book, and the book team paused.
core_idea: RC2 of One Human, Nine Agents, Nineteen Hours was printed by Prontaprint Chiswick as two A4 paperback review copies of 106 pages, not for sale. After the shop's own conversion came out a bit off, the book team's conductor set the book for A4 itself, with its own chapter-end fit, a redrawn cover and a page listing every option the shop needed. The edition for sale is Crown Quarto, for Amazon KDP and Leanpub. The newsroom's opening spread and title page are in the book, and the twenty-two-agent team is paused until the printed copies are read.
